standard_api_equivalent.note: Standard short-context token estimate; subscription usage, not a bill. No cache-write tokens reported. Maximum recorded request input 121759 tokens.

operator_observations.opus: Literally faster; author was impressed by the speed for graphics code. Closer to the requested 90s aesthetic, including the Windows settings screen styles.
operator_observations.sol: Better overall site and Tetris; seven screensavers, no sharks or whales.
operator_observations.vibe: Claude had a MIDI button and sound. Codex included a visitor counter and coffee cup; the author thinks it may have interpreted the brief as a modern website with an old theme.
operator_observations.sol_play: Feels smoother, has a density feature, and Asteroid Field is chill and matches the polished look. Digital Rain gets the Matrix/Hackers vibe.
operator_observations.tetris: Codex piece distribution felt closer to real Tetris. Author reports too few long pieces from Claude, even early on when difficulty should be lower. These are author play impressions, not a statistical distribution test.
operator_observations.windows_settings: Blue header with white text, corner X returns to carousel, CRT screensaver display, dropdown, preview, speed, and silly descriptions.
operator_observations.density: Codex adds density alongside speed; Claude has no density control. Author explicitly keeps this in prose, without another table point.
operator_observations.teapots: Claude added teapots to the pipes. Author looked for the rare teapots without spotting one, but did see all-teapots mode.

demo_hosting_change: Only dist/index.html asset URLs changed from /assets/ to ./assets/. Asset JS and CSS copied byte-for-byte; no rebuild.
feature_status_note: Operator observations and preserved screenshots/source; browser checks are recorded separately.

operator_final_score.cost_comment: Codex could make 3 of Claude's sites for the same price.
